title: Fixed Arched Record Selection Cabinet
description: One newly authored complete static jukebox-style record-selection cabinet. A continuous thick upright arched case and full rear wall stand on one ground plinth; an open upper bay holds five whole dark fixed records with plain small centres on a common stepped support rack. A complete pitched central selector fascia carries eight separate blank fixed buttons. The lower continuous compartment contains a real recessed thick driver cone behind seven separated full vertical grille rails with actual open gaps, inside a continuous contrasting arch trim. This is not the old rectangular open-driver speaker cabinet with circular exposed baffles and reflex duct, or a low gramophone cabinet with a horizontal single platter and tall external flared horn; all numeric geometry is independently authored as one upright stacked record-selection equipment appearance. One whole model, zero scenes; records and buttons are constituents, not extra assets. Three constant opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and whole ground-centred origin. No glass, luminous tubes, labels, trademarks, music, loose media or room. The upper bay is deliberately open for the fixed display, not a simulated transparent enclosure. No selector mechanism, record-changing motion, playback, sound, acoustic/electrical performance, historical authenticity, load, fabrication or safety claim.
